title: Source
description: Anything captured that helps describe how a job is done: an interview, a protocol document, a training video, an existing artefact (a family library, a model, a drawing set), a script. Sources are recorded, not interpreted. Capture phase.

kind.description: told = a person explained it (interview, answer to a question, minutes). found = it exists in an artefact and is read from it (harvested). documented = someone wrote or recorded it as guidance (protocol, standard, manual, training video).

domain.description: The adapter/domain this source belongs to, e.g. 'revit-families', 'revit-model', 'general'.

captureRun.description: The capture run that produced or read this source, if any.
